title: SAS initiator: OOB (COMRESET / COMINIT) bring-up, then an SSP-style frame link (SOF, header, payload, CRC-32, EOF, ALIGN idle) with a built-in write / read-verify sequencer over a 16 x 32-bit register file

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a received frame failed (CRC error, bad EOF, oversize length, unknown type, bad register address, missing payload) or a transaction timed out

notes: tx_p / tx_n (serial out, 1 bit per PCLK), rx_p / rx_n (serial in; only rx_p is sampled) and refclk (unused by the simplified model) pass through unchanged. The initiator runs on its own after reset and verifies its own traffic over the link.
The registers report the link's error events; frame contents stay on the serial pins.
